projects.name: Project 2 – Linfox {AUS, NZ} [12/2021 – 09/2023]
details:  Linfox is Australia's largest privately-owned logistics company, providing integrated supply chain solutions across the Asia Pacific region.
 Acted as a key SAP EWM consultant, supporting warehouse operations and enhancing efficiency for Linfox.
 Managed and resolved stuck queues, including resolving issues with HU stuck on resources, and retriggered orders through WebMethods.
 Contributed to the outbound processes, ensuring effective goods issue, picking, loading, and shipping operations in line with company
standards.
 Played a vital role in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for implementing process and system changes.
 Handled critical tickets related to warehouse management processes such as sales orders, inbound/outbound deliveries, STOs, and shipments.
 Supported SAP EWM integration with other modules and third-party systems for seamless operation.
